messages:
Ivy: Quick PSA - someone took the communal Greek yogurt without leaving a note and theres a half-eaten container in the fridge with no name. Also coffee pods dwindling. Anyone heading out around 12:40 for a shop run? :eyes:
Marcus: Oh no, thats me in the bad-lunch thief club. I'll swing by and grab new yogurt and coffee. Can you list what to buy?
Jo: Thanks Marcus! Can you pick up: 6 single-serve Greek yogurts (vanilla + plain), 1 box regular coffee pods, 1 decaf, oat creamer, and a small pack of spoons? Also maybe some cut fruit for the table?
Felipe: Also can we get non-dairy creamer options (soy or almond) and a container of mixed nuts? People keep asking.
Ivy: Add bananas and a small box of tea bags (green + chamomile).
supply-bot: supply-bot: Current inventory snapshot: coffee_pods_regular=3, coffee_pods_decaf=0, greek_yogurt=0, oat_creamer=1, sugar=4, tea_bags=2. Auto-reorder status: off. Use `/kitchen-reorder` to create a one-off order.
Marcus: I'll use company card. Will aim for ETA 13:05. If anyone wants something else, shout now.
Jo: Could you also grab one package of gluten-free crackers? Maya mentioned them earlier.
Felipe: Please avoid buying the large tubs of trail mix that have artificial candy bits. Small mixed-nut only.
Ivy: Can we add a tiny laminated sign: "Please label personal items and toss after 72h"? Fridge is chaos.
Marcus: Sure, I'll print a dry-erase sheet and stick it on the door.
Jo: Also microwave is spicy again - put a note: "If you splatter, cover your food or clean it". Seriously.
Marcus: Back at 13:03. Restocked: yogurts x6, coffee pods reg + decaf, oat creamer, soy creamer, bananas x8, tea box, gluten-free crackers, mixed nuts. Left receipt on the counter and uploaded photo to #finance as REDWOOD-KITCHEN-2026.
supply-bot: supply-bot: Inventory updated: coffee_pods_regular=6, coffee_pods_decaf=2, greek_yogurt=6, oat_creamer=2, soy_creamer=1, tea_bags=10, bananas=8, mixed_nuts=1, gf_crackers=1. Reminder: enable auto-reorder via `/kitchen-reorder enable` for monthly ship.
Felipe: Thank you!! I labeled the mixed nuts. Also added a tiny sticky on the fridge about 72h rule.
Ivy: Legend. I'll make a quick rota doc for kitchen runs (1 person/week) and share later.
Jo: Love the rota idea. Also can we get a little box of disposable utensils labeled "for immediate use only" so people don't borrow forks from others?
Marcus: Noted. Glad we got it sorted.
